_comment: Nebraska 2026/2027/2028 9% LIHTC, NIFA. Coded from the 5-page scoresheet, which carries the point values. The 36-page Allocation Plan (nebraska-9pct-allocation-plan-2026-2027-2028.pdf) defers scoring to the application: its only point table (p.6) is headed 'NIFA LIHTC PROPOSED SCORING' and sums to 94, and it disagrees with the sheet on QCT (3 vs 2), Natural Disaster (3 vs 2) and Efficient Housing Production (9 vs 6). The plan's tie rule (p.15) points to 'the outlined Final Ranking in the 9% NIFA/NDED Application', which is not bundled. The scoresheet's text layer separates labels from values, so every value was read from rendered page images and the quotes are labels the text layer does carry. Page numbers are PDF page indices. TWO POOLS coded as full parallel tracks, non_metro and metro (metro labels carry '.M'), because the sheet states a total for each: 'Non-Metro Max Points = 87 / Metro Max Points = 85' (p.5), with Other Selection Criteria subtotals of 74 and 72 and a 40-point minimum on that subtotal (p.2). Hand-summed before loading. Shared criteria at their block maxima: 2 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 3 + 2 + 1 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 4 + 8 + 6 + 8 + 4 + 4 + 6 + 1 + 2 + 1 = 69. Non-metro adds 2 + 1 + 3 = 6, giving an Other Selection Criteria subtotal of 75. Metro adds 4, giving 73. NIFA-scored criteria add 5 + 6 + 2 = 13, for 88 and 86. So a flat sum overshoots each stated figure by exactly 1, and no reading of the printed rows yields 74/72. The sheet also prints two exclusions: CROWN developments cannot take Mixed Income (3), and DHHS-DBH (1) is barred with Section 811 (4). Honouring them, the reachable maxima are 84 and 82. The MISMATCH against 87/85 stands by design. Negative: -3 for a LIHTC increase request in the last 12 months. Threshold exhibits are in NE_thresholds.json.

track_totals.note: 'Non-Metro Max Points = 87'; Other Selection Criteria subtotal 74. Flat sum of block maxima 88 (75 + 13); 84 honouring the sheet's two exclusions.
'Metro Max Points = 85'; subtotal 72. Flat sum 86 (73 + 13); 82 honouring the exclusions.
